shows.title: Old Masters in New York
shows.summary: Sotheby's is presenting Old Masters in New York, featuring masterworks from the third millennium B.C. to the nineteenth century, including the remarkable Diane A. Nixon Collection and the Master Paintings & Works of Art Part I sale.

shows.title: Master Paintings & Works of Art Part I
shows.summary: This year's Master Paintings & Works of Art Part I sale features works of exceptional rarity and provenance, including Antonello da Messina's double-sided Ecce Homo and a magnificent 1500 millefleurs unicorn tapestry from the Cindy and Jay Pritzker Collection.

shows.title: Master Works on Paper from Five Centuries
shows.summary: The highly anticipated Master Works on Paper from Five Centuries sale features Rembrandt's Young Lion Resting, a rarity in Rembrandt's oeuvre and the only animal depiction by the artist remaining in private hands.
